headline: Oil rises above $108 after attack in Hormuz and closure of Saudi pipeline shakes markets
summary: Brent crude rose above $108 a barrel after a commercial ship was hit in the Strait of Hormuz, killing a crew member, and Saudi Arabia shut its main bypass pipeline.
why: Brent is the main global crude benchmark, and disruptions to Gulf shipping and pipeline routes directly affect global oil supply and prices.
why_moved: A commercial ship was hit in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi Arabia shut its main pipeline bypassing the waterway, renewing fears of Middle East supply disruption.
